items.summary: Port covers only the cudaCoord (CUDA/Thrust/CUB) plugin. Excluded GPU surfaces: openaccPTM plugin (NVIDIA OpenACC offload via nvc++, the USEGPU path) -- no production ROCm OpenACC analogue; SAXS ArrayFire-CUDA backend (ArrayFire OpenCL could target AMD); core OpenACC infra (src/tools/OpenACC.h) and the libtorch-CUDA pytorch module. All opt-in/default-off.
